meta.name: Customer testimonial
meta.description: A vertical testimonial for Reels laid out in HTML and CSS: a serif quote with bold and accent words inside one sentence, a round customer portrait with name and role, star rating chips drawn with clip-path, then a shop card.
meta.creativeDirection: Audience: small shops that turn a customer review into a Reel. Direction: the words are the hero. A large serif quote fills the upper half, with the two words that sell set bold in the accent colour inside the sentence; the opening quote mark fades in first, the quote rises, then the customer slides in with a round portrait and the rating lands last as five star chips. A push-up transition hands over to a calm shop card. Everything stays inside the Reels safe zone, clear of the header, the caption row and the action buttons. Review: the quote reads in one pass, line breaks never strand a single word, stars are crisp, the portrait is round with no square corner, and each layer waits for its entrance.

quote_tail.default: and look even better on our shelves.

sections.name: review
sections.purpose: Let a customer say it, with the proof underneath.

inputs.name: quote_text
inputs.css: .quote { margin: 0; color: $color.fg; font: 400 64px $font.display; line-height: 1.1; text-shadow: 0 2px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) } strong { color: $color.accent; font-weight: 800 }

inputs.name: customer_row
inputs.html: {{ customer }}{{ customer_role }}
inputs.css: .wrap { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; padding: 0 24px 30px } .row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 22px; padding: 16px 30px 16px 16px; border-radius: 999px; background: $color.surface@0.9; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35) } .portrait { width: 96px; height: 96px; border-radius: 48px; object-fit: cover; object-position: 40% 30%; border: 3px solid $color.accent } .who { display: flex; flex-direction: column } strong { color: $color.fg; font: 600 34px $font.body } span { color: $color.muted; font: 400 24px $font.body }

inputs.name: rating_chips
inputs.html: {{ rating }}
inputs.css: .row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px } .chip { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 18px; background: $color.accent } .star { width: 38px; height: 38px; background: $color.bg; clip-path: polygon(50% 0%, 61% 35%, 98% 35%, 68% 57%, 79% 91%, 50% 70%, 21% 91%, 32% 57%, 2% 35%, 39% 35%) } .score { display: flex; margin-left: 10px; padding: 12px 22px; border-radius: 999px; background: $color.surface@0.9; color: $color.fg; font: 600 30px $font.body }

sections.name: shop
sections.purpose: Name the shop and send the viewer to it.

inputs.name: shop_card
inputs.html:
Thank you for the review

{{ shop }}

{{ offer }}

{{ cta }}
inputs.css: .wrap { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; padding: 0 24px 34px } .card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; flex-grow: 1; gap: 8px; padding: 40px 36px 36px; border-radius: 32px; background: $color.surface@0.94; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35) } .kicker { color: $color.accent; font: 600 20px $font.body; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 3px } h2 { margin: 6px 0 0; color: $color.fg; font: 700 76px $font.display; line-height: 1 } p { margin: 0; color: $color.muted; font: 400 26px $font.body; text-align: center } .cta { display: flex; margin-top: 22px; padding: 16px 34px; border-radius: 999px; background: $color.accent; color: $color.bg; font: 600 28px $font.body }
